ww-koenigsbach.reason: Only GeoNames place in Baden-Wuerttemberg whose name starts with Koenigsbach: the municipality Koenigsbach-Stein; the plant is named after the municipality (AMELAG gives no further position).

ww-emschermuendung.reason: Klaerwerk Emscher-Muendung of the Emschergenossenschaft is one of its four large plants and lies in Dinslaken (NRW); a 906k catchment fits a large-scale plant, so the city of Dinslaken is used as the approximate position. Confidence: high.

ww-gleisdreieck.reason: Klaeranlage Gleisdreieck (KWA Meininger Umland) lies between Obermassfeld and Untermassfeld (Thuringia); the municipality Obermassfeld-Grimmenthal has about 2.5k inhabitants, matching the 2,468 catchment. Confidence: medium-high.

ww-leinetal.reason: Verbandsklaeranlage Leinetal of the WAZ Obereichsfeld (largest of its 24 plants) lies in the municipality Uder (Eichsfeld, Thuringia; reports also name the district Schoenau); the municipality is used as the approximate position. Confidence: medium.

ww-linsenstein.reason: The central plant 'Linsenstein' of the AZV Thueringer Pforte stands on the former sugar-factory sludge beds in Oldisleben (Thuringia); it serves most member municipalities, hence the catchment of 8.5k. Confidence: medium-high.

ww-rollsdorf.reason: Central plant Rollsdorf of the AZV Eisleben-Suesser See (about 50k inhabitants/EW connected) lies in the district Rollsdorf of Seegebiet Mansfelder Land; Rollsdorf itself is not in the GeoNames cities dump, so the neighbouring district Seeburg of the same municipality (about 2 km away) is used. Confidence: medium.

ww-silstedt.reason: The central plant of the WAHB (Wasser- und Abwasserverband Holtemme-Bode) is in Wernigerode-Silstedt and serves the town; Silstedt is not in the GeoNames cities dump, so the town Wernigerode (about 5 km away) is used, which also fits the 45k catchment. Confidence: high for the town, approximate for the plant.

ww-wellesweiler.reason: EVS plant Neunkirchen-Wellesweiler (Am Ochsenwald 2a, Neunkirchen/Saar) treats the inner city and surroundings of Neunkirchen; Wellesweiler is not in the GeoNames cities dump, so the city of Neunkirchen (about 3 km away; 50k inhabitants vs 44.9k catchment) is used. Confidence: high.

ww-wustweiler.reason: EVS plant Illingen-Wustweiler lies west of Wustweiler (district of Illingen, Saarland) and treats wastewater of Illingen, Merchweiler, Schiffweiler, Quierschied and Marpingen; Wustweiler is not in the GeoNames cities dump, so the municipality seat Illingen (about 3 km away) is used. Confidence: high for the municipality.
